title: Billing checkout timeout
summary: A routing configuration caused checkout requests to time out for customers in the northern region. The rollback restored service.

title: Search index delay
summary: Search results were delayed while an index rebuild completed. No customer transaction was lost.

title: Billing routing recovery
summary: A stale routing rule delayed billing confirmation for some customers. The team removed the rule and verified recovery.

title: Report export failure
summary: Scheduled report exports failed after a dependency update. Manual exports remained available.

title: Authentication latency
summary: Authentication latency increased during a cache restart. The service recovered after capacity was restored.

title: Data import duplicate alert
summary: A duplicate import alert was raised and resolved before customer records were changed.
